description: Land Acquisition - Battaramulla, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District - Tennehenwala, Walapane D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1852/73 of 07'03'2014 by Maharagama D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes (flood control and environmental improvement projects). It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, boundaries, and procedures for compensation claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
